Key Findings

  • Initial access through a reused VPN credential without MFA.
  • Domain admin obtained from a plaintext password in an IT share.
  • Flat network with no segmentation between the business LAN and the OT/SCADA VLAN.
  • Production database backups stored on a file server reachable from the office network.
  • Customers and the state utility regulator will be notified at publication.

Data Obtained

  • Customer billing records (names, addresses, bank/ACH details)
  • SCADA and plant control configuration exports
  • Network diagrams for treatment and distribution sites
  • Operational technology credentials and VPN configs
  • Municipal service contracts and compliance filings
  • HR, payroll and employee records
  • Finance: management accounts, audit working papers, tax
